tagline: Football match reports where every sentence is checked against the event log before you see it.
mt_note: Interface and summaries are machine-translated from the verified English. Names and numbers are checked to be unchanged.
flag_draw_vs_edge: A draw, although one side had the better chances
tap_sentence: Select a sentence to see its evidence on the pitch.
ev_only: only the players in this sentence
ev_none: This sentence is about the whole match, so there is no single place on the pitch to show.
ev_noloc: This event has no position on the pitch.
pitch_label: Pitch with the players and passes behind this sentence
tl_sub_injury: {team} replaced {replaced} with {player}, because of an injury.
tl_injury_continued: {player} ({team}) was treated for {secs} seconds and played on.
tl_injury_substituted: {player} ({team}) was treated for {secs} seconds and could not continue.
tl_big_saved: {player} ({team}) had a big chance that was saved.
tl_big_off_target: {player} ({team}) had a big chance and shot off target.
tl_big_blocked: {player} ({team}) had a big chance that was blocked.
tl_spell: From minute {frm} to {to}, {team} had the better chances.
ask_hint: Pick a question, or type your own.
ask_placeholder: Type a question about this match
ask_stored: Answers to these questions were prepared and checked in advance.
ask_live: Your own question is answered live and goes through the same checks.
ask_live_off: Live questions are not switched on in this build. Pick one of the prepared questions.
ask_live_fail: The live service did not answer in time. Pick one of the prepared questions.
ask_live_cap: The live question allowance for this demo has been used up. Pick one of the prepared questions.
ask_slow: This takes about 10 to 20 seconds, because every answer is checked twice.
trust_title: How much can you trust this?
trust_lead: A second program re-checks every sentence against the raw event log. Wrong sentences are blocked or rewritten before you see them.
tr_first: Recap sentences blocked on first draft
tr_data: All match data is synthetic. Teams, players and matches are invented.
tr_note: The test deliberately inserts wrong sentences to see whether the checks catch them.
tr_step_n: {n} drafted, {b} blocked on the first pass
load_fail: Could not load this data. Please reload.
no_recap: The recap for this match is not ready yet.
synthetic: Synthetic data. No real clubs, players or matches.
footer: Built for the Microsoft x Premier League Inside the Game hackathon. Synthetic data only.
q1: Why did the result go the way it did?
q2: Which player was rated highest and why?
q3: How many shots did the home team have in the second half?
q5: How many fouls did the away team commit?
q8: What formation did the away team play?
q9: How long will the injured player be out for?
q10: Was the referee right to book that player?
